reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI benefits for health and development
themes.definition: AI presented as delivering concrete benefits in health, science and development, including partnerships to share these benefits with developing countries.
themes.inclusion: Passages citing AI speeding cancer diagnosis, drug discovery, AI for development partnerships in Africa or SDG ecosystems.
themes.exclusion: Economic growth/productivity framing without health or development content (use AI_ECONOMY_LABOR).
themes.boundary_cases: Donor-funded AI ecosystem programmes abroad count here and may also count as AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING.

examples.quote: In our National Health Service, AI mammogram trials double the speed of diagnosis.
working with 10 African partners creating AI ecosystems that empower thousands of communities to meet the sustainable development goals
not just to help prevent and treat cancer, but to help cure it

themes.label: AI growth, jobs and worker disruption
themes.definition: AI as a driver of productivity and growth and as a source of labour disruption requiring support for workers, including industrial-revolution analogies.
themes.inclusion: Passages on AI productivity gains, reindustrialisation, jobs of the future, or protecting workers through disruption.
themes.boundary_cases: National investment in AI industries to create jobs counts here and in AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY.

examples.quote: AI will also be a source of disruption to the way we live and work, a multiplier of risk.
we are driving investment in industries of the future to create new jobs, from low-carbon technologies to artificial intelligence

themes.label: AI-enabled disinformation and propaganda
themes.definition: AI used by hostile states and actors to spread propaganda, manipulate information and amplify disinformation.
themes.inclusion: Passages on AI fuelling disinformation, chatbots manipulated to repeat propaganda, or AI multiplying information threats.
themes.exclusion: AI-enabled financial scams and crime without an information-manipulation focus (use AI_CYBER_SECURITY).
themes.boundary_cases: A passage where AI is said to multiply the threat of disinformation and cyber attacks together can take both codes.

examples.quote: Authoritarian states, notably Russia, are manipulating large-scale, large model language models so that chatbots answer in the voice of their propaganda
we have seen cyber attacks on companies and institutions, and we know that AI will multiply the threat

themes.label: AI misuse by criminals and security threats
themes.definition: AI used for crime, scams, repression, or threats to critical infrastructure, and AI as a security tool to defend against them.
themes.inclusion: Passages on criminals using AI for scams, AI empowering crime, or AI defence partnerships to protect critical infrastructure.
themes.exclusion: Autonomous weapons or battlefield AI (use AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS).
themes.boundary_cases: Defensive AI for national infrastructure counts here rather than military weapons.

examples.quote: Organised crime is using AI to supercharge their scams, deceiving victims on an unprecedented scale.
we are developing a new AI defense partnership with the United States to protect our critical national infrastructure

themes.label: Frontier AI safety and preparedness
themes.definition: Concern with frontier AI safety, investing in AI safety/security institutes, and global standards to ensure safe AI development.
themes.inclusion: Passages mentioning AI Security/Safety Institutes, safe AI development, frontier AI risks and preparedness.
themes.exclusion: Crime or disinformation misuse (use those codes).
themes.boundary_cases: Calls for global safety standards take both this and AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: we have our world-leading AI Security Institute, working hand in glove with the US and the leading labs on AI safety
to ensure that AI development is safe

themes.label: Global AI principles via G20 and UN
themes.definition: Calls for shared global principles and standards on AI through G20, UN processes and cooperation, including endorsement of UN AI bodies.
themes.inclusion: Passages proposing global AI principles/standards, putting AI at the heart of a G20 presidency, or welcoming UN AI governance dialogue and scientific panel.
themes.boundary_cases: Welcoming the UN Scientific Panel and Global Dialogue should also be coded AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: we will work towards agreeing a single set of global principles and standards
I commend the new independent international scientific panel on AI

themes.label: Sharing AI benefits to avoid inequality
themes.definition: Concern that AI benefits are concentrated and must be shared globally to prevent deeper inequality.
themes.inclusion: Passages urging investment and partnership so AI benefits reach those who need them, or warning technological change could deepen inequality.
themes.exclusion: Concentration of power framed as sovereignty/dependence (use AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION).
themes.boundary_cases: Digital access programmes narrowing the technological divide count here.

examples.quote: we risk a world of ever deeper inequality, where the benefits of this technology fail to reach those who need it most
the risk that technological change could become a source of inequality and division rather than the greatest opportunity in history

themes.label: Own-country AI leadership and investment
themes.definition: Speaker showcases own country's AI talent, institutions, investment and national leadership role.
themes.inclusion: Passages boasting national AI talent, institutes, datasets or national-level AI investments and initiatives.
themes.exclusion: International proposals for common rules (use AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE).
themes.boundary_cases: Announcing a national G20 agenda on AI counts as both national positioning and global governance.

examples.quote: The UK has some of the best tech and AI talent anywhere in the world.
we invest so heavily in the AI Security Institute, with more dedicated researchers than anywhere else in the world

themes.label: AI can empower freedom or repression
themes.definition: Explicit framing of AI as both a defining opportunity and a profound challenge whose direction depends on choices.
themes.inclusion: Passages contrasting AI's potential to empower good versus harm.
themes.boundary_cases: Describing frontier AI as one of the most significant challenges and opportunities counts.

examples.quote: AI can empower freedom or it can entrench repression. AI can empower truth or it can entrench lies.
one of the most significant challenges and opportunities of our age, frontier AI

value.rationale: All passages are UK speeches; they substantively cover AI health/development benefits, growth and labour disruption, disinformation and crime misuse, frontier safety, and global principles, framed as dual-edged, with earlier years (2018, 2022) only briefly referencing AI as an industry of the future.
